name: BSP_WarningManager_Update
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet mission_events_update, read-only analysis. Supersedes BSP_MissionEvents_Update: the object at game+21E0h is the WarningManager, not a mission-objective director. 009763e0 prints 'WarningManager Report Error' and 'WarningManager unknown message id: %s' and 009781e0 prints '---WarningManager invalid Message--- %d', all on this object and all taking its critical section at +24h. __thiscall(this, float), RET 4 at 00987748, ECX game+21E0h from BSP_Game_OnMove at 004e4e67. Runs 00982540, then the +198h accumulator which fires 00977990 on strictly greater than 4.0f (00ce3d34) and is reset to zero at 009875d1 rather than decremented, then 0096d540 and 00968550. Walks the std::list<Warning*> at +E0h: retire when warning+10h <= now - vtable[1Ch](), destroying through vtable[0h](1) and returning at once, so one retirement per frame; otherwise 005b71d0 gates readiness and the strictly higher vtable[18h]() priority wins. 00974070 applies the survivor. 00974070 writes the clock into warning+10h, so +10h is the apply timestamp and vtable[1Ch] the lifetime; docs/GAME_WORLD_ENTITIES.md has those two roles swapped. docs/MISSION_EVENTS_UPDATE.md.

name: BSP_SpatialIndex_SweepSegments
